body:
Adds **C_89b, the Ramsey multiplicity constant of $K_5$** (the minimum density of monochromatic $K_5$ over 2-colourings of $K_n$), as a second member of the family of C_89 ($K_4$). It also records a **new certified upper bound**, $C_{89b} \le 0.0016870052$*. Markdown only: `constants/89b.md`, README rows (the existing 89 row is relabelled 89a), and a "Recent progress" line.

| side | bound | source |
|---|---|---|
| upper | $1/512$ | Erdős 1962 (random colouring; conjectured sharp) |
| upper | $0.001769$, $0.001720$ | Thomason 1989, 1997 (as summarised by PPSS) |
| upper | $2320651 \cdot 2^{-24} \cdot 3^{-4} < 0.001708$ | Parczyk–Pokutta–Spiegel–Szabó, FoCM 2024, Thm 1.2 (192-vertex Cayley graph) |
| upper | **$0.0016870052$*** | this PR, details below |
| lower | $0.001524$ | PPSS 2024, Thm 1.2 (flag algebras) |

The floating-point flag algebra value $0.001557$ of Kiem–Pokutta–Spiegel (arXiv:2312.08049), which they did not certify, is mentioned under "Additional comments" only.

**The new bound.** I start from the PPSS 192-vertex graph (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6602512, CC-BY-4.0) read as a step graphon: red between blocks joined by an edge, blue inside blocks. That reproduces their value. Projected gradient descent then moves all 18,528 block-pair densities, inside-block ones included, until the line search stalls; the result is rounded to multiples of $2^{-20}$. The density is computed **exactly over every pair of blocks**: the integer numerator $N(R) + N(2^{20} - R)$, with $N(R) = \sum_{i,j} R_{ij} \operatorname{tr}((\mathrm{diag}(R_i \circ R_j) R)^3)$, modulo 11 primes, combined by CRT, plus a check prime. The evaluator shares no code with the search, reproduces PPSS's $2320651/1358954496$ exactly, and agrees with brute force on small cases. The result is

$107218716425177032911811117405568916263805081691166740697/63555655070790142733837367909977622463036348875198349443072 = 0.0016870051344094\ldots$,

that is $2.07 \times 10^{-5}$ below PPSS. Certificate, checker and search code are at [JeetuSK0808/tao-constants-certificates@82a6e4d](https://github.com/JeetuSK0808/tao-constants-certificates/tree/82a6e4def9c63e9a7254bc2393f61a872891c480/c89b-k5-ramsey-multiplicity) (`python3 exact5.py c89b_stepgraphon_m192_D20.json.gz`, a few minutes). It is asterisked as self-hosted.

The lint script from earlier PRs reports no new warnings against main. I numbered the page 89b because it belongs to the 89 family; renumbering is fine.

**AI use:** prepared with Claude Code (Anthropic), which located and checked the sources, drafted the page, and wrote the search and the exact evaluator. Disclosed in the page's Contribution notes as well.

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+# Ramsey multiplicity constant of $K\_5$
+
+## Description of constant
+
+For a 2-colouring of the edges of the complete graph $K\_n$, let $k\_5$ be the number of $5$-element vertex sets whose ten edges all have the same colour. The **Ramsey multiplicity constant of $K\_5$** is
+
+$$
+C_{89b} := \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{\min k_5}{\binom{n}{5}},
+$$
+
+the minimum over all 2-colourings of $K\_n$, or equivalently the minimum density of monochromatic $K\_5$ in a 2-edge-coloured graphon. It is often written $c\_5$ or $m\_2(5)$. Erdős conjectured that the random colouring is optimal, $C\_{89b} = 2^{1-10} = 1/512$ [Erd1962]; Thomason disproved this for all $K\_t$ with $t \ge 4$ [Tho1989]. See [C89a](89a.html) for $K\_4$.
+
+## Known upper bounds
+
+| Bound | Reference | Comments |
+| ----- | --------- | -------- |
+| $1/512 \approx 0.001953$ | [Erd1962] | Uniformly random colouring. Erdős conjectured that this is sharp. |
+| $0.001769$ | [Tho1989] | Blow-ups of graphs formed by vectors in orthogonal geometries, as summarised in [PPSS2024]. |
+| $0.001720$ | [Tho1997] | Blow-up sequence of an XOR graph product, as summarised in [PPSS2024]. |
+| $2320651 \cdot 2^{-24} \cdot 3^{-4} < 0.001708$ | [PPSS2024] | Theorem 1.2: the sequence of blow-ups of a Cayley graph on $192$ vertices, found by search heuristics. |
+| $0.0016870052$* | [SK2026] | Exact value $107218716425177032911811117405568916263805081691166740697/63555655070790142733837367909977622463036348875198349443072 = 0.0016870051344094\ldots$. A step graphon with $192$ blocks of equal weight: starting from the [PPSS2024] graph (red between blocks joined by an edge, blue inside blocks), all $18528$ block-pair densities, including the inside-block ones, are moved by projected gradient descent and rounded to multiples of $2^{-20}$. The density is computed exactly over every pair of blocks (the integer numerator modulo $11$ primes, combined by CRT, plus a check prime); the same evaluator reproduces the [PPSS2024] value exactly. Data and checker at commit `82a6e4d` of [SK2026]. Asterisked: self-hosted and not independently replayed. |
+
+## Known lower bounds
+
+| Bound | Reference | Comments |
+| ----- | --------- | -------- |
+| $0.001524$ | [PPSS2024] | Theorem 1.2, by flag algebras. |
+
+## Additional comments
+
+- [KPS2023] report that a flag algebra computation on $9$-vertex graphs suggests $C\_{89b} \geq 0.001557$ from the floating-point solver output, but did not turn this into an exact certificate.
+- The upper bounds come from (weighted) blow-ups of finite 2-coloured graphs, or step graphons, whose monochromatic $K\_5$ density can be computed exactly; the lower bounds come from flag algebras.
+
+## References
+
+- [Erd1962] P. Erdős, On the number of complete subgraphs contained in certain graphs, *Magyar Tud. Akad. Mat. Kutató Int. Közl.* 7 (1962), 459–464.
+- [KPS2023] A. Kiem, S. Pokutta and C. Spiegel, The four-color Ramsey multiplicity of triangles, [arXiv:2312.08049](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.08049) (2023).
+- [PPSS2024] O. Parczyk, S. Pokutta, C. Spiegel and T. Szabó, New Ramsey multiplicity bounds and search heuristics, *Foundations of Computational Mathematics* (2024), [doi:10.1007/s10208-024-09675-6](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10208-024-09675-6). [arXiv:2206.04036](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.04036). Graphs at [doi:10.5281/zenodo.6602512](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6602512).
+- [SK2026] J. SK, Certified step graphon for the Ramsey multiplicity of $K\_5$, [github.com/JeetuSK0808/tao-constants-certificates](https://github.com/JeetuSK0808/tao-constants-certificates/tree/82a6e4def9c63e9a7254bc2393f61a872891c480/c89b-k5-ramsey-multiplicity) (2026), commit `82a6e4d`.
+- [Tho1989] A. Thomason, A disproof of a conjecture of Erdős in Ramsey theory, *J. London Math. Soc.* (2) 39 (1989), 246–255.
+- [Tho1997] A. Thomason, Graph products and monochromatic multiplicities, *Combinatorica* 17(1) (1997), 125–134.
+
